scoring_notes: Memberships, anchors, rule consequents and weights are public design choices, not market-calibrated relevance.
Fuzzy lifestyle replaces separate fuel/luggage points; these features are not counted twice.
Unknown contributes no supported lower-bound points and widens the upper bound; this is not a quality judgement or statistical confidence interval.

Comfort and reliability coding is attributed opinion, not a failure rate. Exact year, variant and transmission applicability is required.

scoring_anchors.fuzzy_lifestyle: Fuel clip((km/L - 10)/15); boot clip(litres/600). Triangle/shoulder low/medium/high sets; product AND; 0.8 * weighted level + 0.2 * minimum level; weighted mean of rule constants.
scoring_anchors.safety: Confirmed true ESC/AEB/curtain-airbag items / 3; unknown increases bound.
scoring_anchors.comfort: Source-family means of negative=0, mixed=0.5, positive=1, divided by four aspects; two families and two aspects required.
scoring_anchors.reliability: At least two independent ownership-opinion families with ownership period; never failure probability.
